purpose: Deterministic category and order-family rules for generating synthetic prototype candidates without changing runtime or authoritative data.

globalRules.patientSpecificRule: Store the reusable basis, formula, unit, constraints, required inputs, and adjustment reason in the master contract; choose the patient value only in the chart.
globalRules.actualResultRule: Never prefill an actual preparation, administration, acquisition, measurement, interpretation, or finding as a master default.
globalRules.unitRule: Use a machine-readable unit code and validate dimensional compatibility before calculation.
globalRules.roundingRule: Do not apply a universal increment or direction. Record product or tool increment, pre-round value, chosen value, delta, reason, and authorizer.
globalRules.speciesRule: Preserve the frozen order species scope and split rules when the evidence differs by species.

reusableMasterContract: consultation subtype and scope
standard instruction and expected output
default occurrence count and timing where universally valid
encounterInputs: responsible clinician resolved from the authenticated encounter context
actualResults: assessment, diagnosis, recommendation, and completed note
blockingConditions: responsible clinician resolver fails closed
subtype does not define a reusable scope or output

dispensing.product-specific.v1.matchRule: order is linked to an identifiable official product record with product, formulation, strength, species, route, and dosing context
reusableMasterContract: product, active ingredient, formulation, strength or concentration
applicable species and dosing context
dose basis, coefficient or product-unit dose, route, frequency, and duration
calculation formula, variables, units, theoretical total, and dimensional checks
preparation increment, rounding policy, storage, dispenser instruction, and guardian instruction
encounterInputs: patient weight or other ordered basis
indication and veterinarian-selected coefficient where not fixed by the exact order
patient-specific frequency, duration, taper, contraindication, and extra-label reason
blockingConditions: official product identity or strength is missing
species or indication applicability is unresolved
formula dimensions do not match
rounded total lacks a product or tool rule and reason

dispensing.generic-unresolved.v1.matchRule: order lacks an identifiable product or ingredient-strength-formulation context
requiredResolution: split the generic order into identifiable product or ingredient-strength-formulation orders
link an applicable official product document
regenerate formulas, units, instructions, and totals
dispensing.generic-unresolved.v1.prohibitedResolution: Do not copy values from another medicine or generate a plausible-looking dose, route, frequency, duration, or total.

reusableMasterContract: method and preparation steps
planned amount basis, formula, unit, range, and adjustment rule when applicable
default site policy, frequency, schedule, staged instructions, and exception criteria
actualResults: materials, complications, outcome, and completion state
blockingConditions: administeredAmount remains required before confirmation
planned amount has no order-specific basis or unit
a universal fluid or treatment quantity is substituted for a patient decision

reusableMasterContract: versioned panel and analyte membership
specimen, container, additive, minimum quantity, collection, pretreatment, storage, delay, and transport rules
result type, display unit, machine unit, precision, measuring range, method, analyzer, and site conditions
versioned reference-interval applicability and separately approved critical thresholds
workspaceContract: locally verified or provisional reference-interval adoption state
encounterInputs: patient dimensions required by interval applicability
actualResults: method, analyzer, specimen, and site snapshot
applicable reference bounds and version snapshot
calculated interpretation flag and result status
blockingConditions: panel analytes are not versioned
specimen handling is a generic placeholder
analyzer-specific ranges are presented as locally validated
low or high flags are stored as static master defaults

reusableMasterContract: modality, anatomy region, view or position set, and expected acquisition count
protocol preparation, acquisition, quality check, and required output
contrast and sedation policy as required, not required, or patient-decided
encounterInputs: contrast and sedation plan when patient-decided
actualResults: findings, impression, signature, final state, and addendum history
blockingConditions: modality, region, or protocol family is unresolved
a global view count is used without modality-region context
an unsupported universal contrast dose or sedation value is emitted

reusableMasterContract: duration, care level, monitoring interval, and nursing plan
diet assessment and plan structure
isolation applicability, escalation criteria, and handover requirements
workspaceContract: ward or cage selected from the authorized workspace resource catalog
workspace staffing role and monitoring capabilities
encounterInputs: diet amount, route, frequency, and restriction
blockingConditions: ward or cage resolver is absent or falls back
monitoring or diet detail is a generic placeholder
actual intake is stored as a default

reusableMasterContract: body system, comprehensive or focused scope, and examination method
conditional site, laterality, measurement, and not-examined rules
blockingConditions: proposed order lacks persisted master identity
species scope is unresolved
normal or abnormal finding is prefilled from the master

reusableMasterContract: explicit subtype and structured task instruction
required actor, destination, prerequisites, output type, and completion rule for that subtype
actualResults: signatures, submission, acknowledgement, and output attachment
emergency event timeline and outcomes when applicable
blockingConditions: structuredValue is only a repeat of the display name
subtype-specific output or completion rule is absent
actual document or emergency result is prefilled as a default
